points.text: INDIA bloc rally at **Ramlila Maidan**: Rahul Gandhi accused CEC **Gyanesh Kumar** of 'treason' over the SIR; the BJP held a counter-rally on the **1984 riots**.
points.plain: INDIA bloc rally at Ramlila Maidan: Rahul Gandhi accused CEC Gyanesh Kumar of 'treason' over the SIR; the BJP held a counter-rally on the 1984 riots.

points.text: *The Hindu* found **1,000+ discrepant entries** in Bengaluru's post-SIR rolls; BJP chief **Nitin Nabin** alleged 'three crore infiltrators'.
points.plain: The Hindu found 1,000+ discrepant entries in Bengaluru's post-SIR rolls; BJP chief Nitin Nabin alleged 'three crore infiltrators'.

points.text: Bihar: independent MLCs **Bansidhar Brajwasi** and **Rahul Raj** 'joined' the BJP, then said they only backed it; RJD sought disqualification under the **Tenth Schedule**.
points.plain: Bihar: independent MLCs Bansidhar Brajwasi and Rahul Raj 'joined' the BJP, then said they only backed it; RJD sought disqualification under the Tenth Schedule.

points.text: West Bengal will give **CAA** citizenship to **2.5 lakh Matuas** by **31 Dec 2026**; only **25,000** have got it so far.
points.plain: West Bengal will give CAA citizenship to 2.5 lakh Matuas by 31 Dec 2026; only 25,000 have got it so far.

points.text: A.P. civic polls: **13 corporations** and **79 municipalities**, turnout **48.03%** (63.30% in 2021).
points.plain: A.P. civic polls: 13 corporations and 79 municipalities, turnout 48.03% (63.30% in 2021).

points.text: CJI **Surya Kant**: **65.5 lakh** cases pend in High Courts (**292** vacancies of 1,122 posts) and nearly **1 lakh** in the Supreme Court.
points.plain: CJI Surya Kant: 65.5 lakh cases pend in High Courts (292 vacancies of 1,122 posts) and nearly 1 lakh in the Supreme Court.

points.text: Amit Shah: **Chandigarh** will be India's first **drug-free** city; **93%** conviction rate in NDPS cases since the new criminal laws began on **4 Aug 2024**.
points.plain: Amit Shah: Chandigarh will be India's first drug-free city; 93% conviction rate in NDPS cases since the new criminal laws began on 4 Aug 2024.

points.text: **AMU**: about **4,000** Women's College students had no vote in the students' union election, the first in **8 years**.
points.plain: AMU: about 4,000 Women's College students had no vote in the students' union election, the first in 8 years.

points.text: **EPFO** marked its **74th** Foundation Day: corpus over **₹32 lakh crore**, **8 crore+** members; Labour Minister **Mansukh Mandaviya**.
points.plain: EPFO marked its 74th Foundation Day: corpus over ₹32 lakh crore, 8 crore+ members; Labour Minister Mansukh Mandaviya.

points.text: **PLFS**: unemployment fell from **6.1% (2017-18)** to **3.2% (2023-24)**, but the **Decent Work Index** only rose 0.247 → 0.302; about **90%** of workers are informal.
points.plain: PLFS: unemployment fell from 6.1% (2017-18) to 3.2% (2023-24), but the Decent Work Index only rose 0.247 → 0.302; about 90% of workers are informal.

points.text: **GST** collections rose **23%** in October to **₹2.31 lakh crore**, the second-highest ever; April-October was up 13.2% to ₹14.77 lakh crore.
points.plain: GST collections rose 23% in October to ₹2.31 lakh crore, the second-highest ever; April-October was up 13.2% to ₹14.77 lakh crore.

points.text: India's solar capacity grew from **2.8 GW (2014)** to **171 GW**; tariffs fell to about **₹2.15/unit**; **PM Surya Ghar** has 21 lakh of a 65-lakh target.
points.plain: India's solar capacity grew from 2.8 GW (2014) to 171 GW; tariffs fell to about ₹2.15/unit; PM Surya Ghar has 21 lakh of a 65-lakh target.

points.text: Power use rose **21.88%** in October to **159.76 billion units**; **Coal India** output was up 19.3%.
points.plain: Power use rose 21.88% in October to 159.76 billion units; Coal India output was up 19.3%.

points.text: Commercial **LPG** rose a third time (Delhi 19-kg to **₹2,820**); **ATF** up ₹1.37 to ₹138.5/litre; domestic LPG unchanged.
points.plain: Commercial LPG rose a third time (Delhi 19-kg to ₹2,820); ATF up ₹1.37 to ₹138.5/litre; domestic LPG unchanged.

points.text: **FPIs** pulled **₹34,843 crore** out of Indian equities in October, a second straight month of outflows.
points.plain: FPIs pulled ₹34,843 crore out of Indian equities in October, a second straight month of outflows.

points.text: Comex **gold** fell **7.26%** to a one-year low of **$3,884.9/oz**; **silver** fell 19.1%.
points.plain: Comex gold fell 7.26% to a one-year low of $3,884.9/oz; silver fell 19.1%.

points.text: **CPI inflation** edged up to **5.54%** by Sept 2026, inside the RBI's **2-6%** band.
points.plain: CPI inflation edged up to 5.54% by Sept 2026, inside the RBI's 2-6% band.

points.text: Delhi's entry curbs on outside **below-BS-VI** vehicles began: day one saw **7,279** checks, **714** turned back, **38** impounded.
points.plain: Delhi's entry curbs on outside below-BS-VI vehicles began: day one saw 7,279 checks, 714 turned back, 38 impounded.

points.text: The 2026 southwest monsoon ended **13% below** the **87 cm** long-period average — the driest on record for **East and Northeast India**.
points.plain: The 2026 southwest monsoon ended 13% below the 87 cm long-period average — the driest on record for East and Northeast India.

points.text: Cyclone **Murasu** was due between **Nellore and Narsapur** (120 km/h) days after **Arnab**, which cost **₹4,600 crore** and flooded 3.5 lakh ha.
points.plain: Cyclone Murasu was due between Nellore and Narsapur (120 km/h) days after Arnab, which cost ₹4,600 crore and flooded 3.5 lakh ha.

points.text: Delhi plans a **3.3-km heritage corridor** on **Netaji Subhash Marg** (Delhi Gate to Kashmere Gate) past the **Red Fort**.
points.plain: Delhi plans a 3.3-km heritage corridor on Netaji Subhash Marg (Delhi Gate to Kashmere Gate) past the Red Fort.

points.text: Bhutan dedicated **Chorten No. 76** of its **108 stupas**, built by **40,000+ volunteers**, to **PM Narendra Modi** at **Gelephu Mindfulness City**.
points.plain: Bhutan dedicated Chorten No. 76 of its 108 stupas, built by 40,000+ volunteers, to PM Narendra Modi at Gelephu Mindfulness City.

points.text: The **UNGA** resolution against the **US embargo on Cuba** (annual since **1992**) passed **130-17** with 18 abstentions; **India voted in favour**.
points.plain: The UNGA resolution against the US embargo on Cuba (annual since 1992) passed 130-17 with 18 abstentions; India voted in favour.

points.text: China's **CPC Fifth Plenum** expelled **33** Central Committee members, including **16 PLA generals**, before the 21st Party Congress in 2027.
points.plain: China's CPC Fifth Plenum expelled 33 Central Committee members, including 16 PLA generals, before the 21st Party Congress in 2027.

points.text: Iran warned a renewed war with the US 'could last longer'; the IRGC said it would have 'no geographic limitations'.
points.plain: Iran warned a renewed war with the US 'could last longer'; the IRGC said it would have 'no geographic limitations'.

points.text: **Lula** won a **fourth** term, beating **Flavio Bolsonaro** **51.79% to 48.21%**.
points.plain: Lula won a fourth term, beating Flavio Bolsonaro 51.79% to 48.21%.

points.text: Pakistan told the Afghan **Taliban** that 'terrorism is a red line'.
points.plain: Pakistan told the Afghan Taliban that 'terrorism is a red line'.

points.text: Ahead of the **3 Nov midterms**, the US DOJ pressed county officials for voter data; Harvard's **ElectIt** model gave Democrats **230 of 435** House seats.
points.plain: Ahead of the 3 Nov midterms, the US DOJ pressed county officials for voter data; Harvard's ElectIt model gave Democrats 230 of 435 House seats.

points.text: The **Defence Acquisition Council** cleared **Project 18A**: **₹80,000 crore** for **next-generation guided-missile destroyers**, about **75% indigenous**, designed by the Navy's **Warship Design Bureau**.
points.plain: The Defence Acquisition Council cleared Project 18A: ₹80,000 crore for next-generation guided-missile destroyers, about 75% indigenous, designed by the Navy's Warship Design Bureau.

points.text: New IAF chief **Ashutosh Dixit** set out the '**VAYU**' framework (Vigilance, Aatmanirbharta, Yukti, Unity) and the motto *Nabha Sparsham Deeptam*.
points.plain: New IAF chief Ashutosh Dixit set out the 'VAYU' framework (Vigilance, Aatmanirbharta, Yukti, Unity) and the motto Nabha Sparsham Deeptam.

points.plain: ACM Ashutosh Dixit became the 29th Chief of the Air Staff on 31 Oct, succeeding A.P. Singh.

points.text: **Mahadev Online Book** promoter **Sourabh Chandrakar** (₹6,000-crore betting scam) was extradited from **Oman** after an Interpol notice.
points.plain: Mahadev Online Book promoter Sourabh Chandrakar (₹6,000-crore betting scam) was extradited from Oman after an Interpol notice.

points.text: Azam Khan went to **14-day judicial custody** in an ED **PMLA** case over farmers' land in Rampur taken for **Mohammad Ali Jauhar University**.

points.text: After **NVS-03**, the 2027-28 Budget gave the **Department of Space ₹17,000 crore** (up from ₹13,705.6 crore).
points.plain: After NVS-03, the 2027-28 Budget gave the Department of Space ₹17,000 crore (up from ₹13,705.6 crore).

points.plain: Binance lost over $6.3 billion in a 29 October hack; Chainalysis blamed North Korea's Lazarus Group.

points.text: Three arrests, including a Sub-Inspector, over an alleged rape **inside a police station** in **Seraikela**, Jharkhand; an SIT was formed.
points.plain: Three arrests, including a Sub-Inspector, over an alleged rape inside a police station in Seraikela, Jharkhand; an SIT was formed.

points.plain: West Bengal notified Group D jobs for a family member of each person killed in political violence over 25 years.

points.plain: 31 October 2026 was Sardar Patel's 151st birth anniversary (National Unity Day); he integrated about 500 princely states.

points.plain: Indian Navy beat BPCL 5-4 on penalties to win the 97th MCC-Murugappa Gold Cup hockey title.

points.text: **Glenn Phillips** set the record for most runs in a bilateral T20I series: **341**, past Phil Salt's 331.
points.plain: Glenn Phillips set the record for most runs in a bilateral T20I series: 341, past Phil Salt's 331.

points.plain: India's men and women won the inaugural Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship at Ahmedabad.

points.plain: Carlos Alcaraz won the Vienna Open, his fourth title of the year.

points.plain: Marc Marquez neared an eighth MotoGP title after winning the Malaysian GP.
